description: BearGPT is an enterprise assistant available to UC Berkeley employees and student employees (18+) via CalNet, supporting up to Protection Level P2 data; it is not generally open to all students.
howToObtain: Employees and eligible student employees (18+) sign up via the BearGPT webpage with CalNet authentication.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: We strongly encourage use of Berkeley-licensed tools, which have been vetted for ethical and risk considerations and include contractual protections not present in most standard consumer licenses. The protection of university licensing is provided only when a users accesses a tool by first authenticating through CalNet. Before using these tools, please review Campus Guidance on the Appropriate Use of AI.
